<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<title>Executive Intelligence Brief — UP Police</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0B0F19;
    --card: #151D2E;
    --card-hover: #1E293B;
    --border: #26354D;
    --text: #F1F5F9;
    --muted: #94A3B8;
    --accent: #38BDF8;
    --accent-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
    --red: #F43F5E;
    --amber: #F59E0B;
    --green: #10B981;
    --purple: #A855F7;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .page {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 28px;
    page-break-after: always;
  }
  .header {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E293B 0%, #0F172A 100%);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 22px 26px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .header::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--purple));
  }
  .top-meta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .badge {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: var(--accent-glow);
    color: var(--accent);
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .sec-tag {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--red);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
  }
  .header h1 {
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #FFF;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .header .sub {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
  }

  .kpi-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .kpi-card {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .kpi-card .val {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #FFF;
  }
  .kpi-card .lbl {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-top: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .grid-2col {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .card {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px 20px;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .card-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .bar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 9px;
  }
  .bar-label {
    width: 90px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .bar-track {
    flex: 1;
    background: #0F172A;
    border-radius: 4px;
    height: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .bar-count {
    width: 50px;
    text-align: right;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #FFF;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .tag-cloud {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .tag-chip {
    background: #0F172A;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  th {
    text-align: left;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 10.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .05em;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
  }
  td {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1A2438;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .footer {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    margin-top: 24px;
  }
</style>
</head>
